about: Stripped size in bytes of `cargo build --release --features cli` (release.yml's command), per target, as ci.yml's Linux `Perf Regression Guard` legs measure it (scripts/binary_size.py, #7390). A pull request fails when its stripped binary grew more than `max_pr_growth` over its base's (a line `[size-growth: ok #N]` in a commit message or the PR body waives it); the budget is only a report on a pull request and on a push to main. A size more than `tolerance` above a budget opens a `binary-size` tracking issue (scheduled.yml's daily `binary-size` job) and fails release.yml: shrink the binary, or set `bytes` to the size CI printed, in a PR of its own. Take the number from CI's log, not a local build: another toolchain, linker or strip moves it by a percent or two.

aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu.measured: CI perf-guard ARM64-Linux, ubuntu-24.04-arm, rustc 1.100.0, 044aa8c52 (PR #7395, job 135648800479)
